description: Gross pay in exact cents. Hourly: regular hours at the rate, overtime hours at a multiplier (default 1.5) and double-time hours at a multiplier (default 2). Weekly: hours above the threshold (default 40) are overtime. Salary: the annual amount is split across 52, 26, 24 or 12 periods so the paychecks add back to the annual amount. Extra straight-time hours are paid at annual / 2080 (52 × 40). Overtime and double-time hours use that same base rate times their multipliers. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wage-calc

hours.description: Hours worked (weekly mode, or extra hours on top of a salary)

rate.description: Hourly rate, or the annual salary in salary mode

weeklyThreshold.description: Weekly mode: hours before overtime, default 40
